optimizedContext.value:
# RefreshImplementationTracking

## Rules
- `execute({ name })`; missing change → `ChangeNotFoundError` code `CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`.
- `GetStatus` and `TransitionChange` delegate refresh here; standalone refresh remains supported. Other read-only use cases project persisted state.
- If `Change.isImplementationTrackingActive` false: load through `ChangeRepository.mutate`; never detect or alter tracking. If true: run targeted detection and persist updates.
- Before detection, collect `ChangeRepository.internalPaths()` and `ArchiveRepository.internalPaths()`; normalize only paths inside project root to project-relative portable form; pass non-empty results as `excludePaths`.
- Project containment requires root equality or separator-bounded descendant; string-prefix siblings excluded; drive-letter case ignored. Root itself maps to empty string and is never exclusion prefix.
- Call `ImplementationDetector.detectModifiedFiles(change, options)`. New returned path → `trackImplementationFile(file, open)`; preserve existing state except `removed` → `open`. Never auto-resolve or auto-ignore.
- Check every tracked non-ignored file on disk: missing → `removed` and remove all file/symbol links; present `removed` file → `open`.
- Sweep links: prune link when `specId` absent from both `change.specIds` and workspace canonical `SpecRepository`.
- Return `ImplementationTrackingProjection` via `projectImplementationTracking`, containing post-refresh `trackedFiles` and `links`.
- Constructor receives `changes`, `archives`, `implementationDetector`.
- `createRefreshImplementationTracking(config, options?)` must call `resolveRefreshImplementationTrackingDeps(resolver)`, then canonical factory. Resolver yields `changes`, `archives`, `implementationDetector`, `files`, `projectRoot`, optional `specRepositories`.

## Constraints
- VCS-backed, delivery-agnostic; no CLI, MCP, watcher coupling.
- Detection demand-driven per invocation.
- Detector paths project-relative and forward-slash-normalized per core:implementation-detector-port.
- Manual add/remove/resolve/ignore remains `UpdateImplementationTracking`.
